$comment: Reelay design system — Nocturne. Authored at a 1920x1080 reference; 1 du = 1 logical px at that reference. scale = screenHeight / 1080; every size multiplies by it. Counts (grid columns, cards per row) derive from remaining width, never from a breakpoint.

ink3.use: metadata, captions; floor for body-size text

ink4.use: idle rail icons only — never text

inkOnArt.use: any glyph over artwork or video; always on a scrim

rules: Semantic colour is always carried by a 4px leading spine PLUS the label text — never colour alone, never a filled banner.
The accent never appears over artwork; artwork gets inkOnArt on a scrim.
Disabled = 45% opacity on whatever ink is in play, and removal from the focus order.

scrim.$rule: No glyph ever touches raw artwork. Every text element over a poster, backdrop or video frame sits on one of these, sized so the ground is >= 78% opaque directly behind the glyphs. All are gradient or flat fills — never a blur.

dialog.use: behind a dialog; flat, not blurred

type.$family: Inter. Two weights only: 400 and 500. Hierarchy is size and space — nothing is bolder than 500.
type.$floor: No text smaller than 17 du (1.55% of screen height).

body.use: synopsis; clamp to 3 lines outside a detail page

label.use: card titles, list rows, buttons; 500 when focused

rules: Body copy never exceeds ~44 characters per line.
Truncate to one line with an ellipsis; marquee the full string only while focused.
Sentence case everywhere except micro. No all-caps titles.
Tabular figures for anything that updates in place: timecodes, seat counts, remaining time.

shape.$note: Buttons are 8, not pills. Only avatars and seat circles are fully round.

elevation.$note: Never stack two shadows. On a dark ground, elevation is an edge plus ambient darkness.

motion.$levelNote: Ordered degradation. Drop one rung at a time and stop when frame budget holds. Focus itself is on no rung.
forbidden: anything that moves while the user is not pressing a button

focus.$signal: Three stacked signals, treated as ONE token. Never tune them apart.

selectedFocused.$note: accent frame plus an ink dot — both facts shown at once

onArtwork.$note: a spine would cover the poster — artwork cards take a 3px accent frame all the way round; the caption steps ink3 -> ink

rules: Exactly one focused element on screen, always.
Focus never rests on a container — only on a leaf.
Removing a focused item reclaims focus inside its own row.
Entering a screen claims focus explicitly; the rail is never left holding it.
Nothing outside the focused element animates on focus change.
Holding the D-pad moves focus at input speed but scrolls the row ONCE, when the key settles.
Scroll stops with the focused card at 80% across the viewport, leaving the next one half-visible.

icons.$note: Weight changes meaning in exactly two places: the active rail item and the play glyph. Never mix weights inside one row.

scale.rule: One scale factor per app instance. No breakpoints, no per-widget scaling.

targets.androidTvFlutter: most boxes report a 1920x1080 logical surface -> 1.0; a 720p stick reports 1280x720 -> 0.667. Clamp the OS text scaler.
targets.appleTvSwiftUI: tvOS lays out at 1920x1080 points on every Apple TV, 4K included -> 1.0, and 1 du = 1 pt.
targets.tabletWeb: same tokens, scale ~0.55 (arm's length). On the web: --du: calc(100vh / 1080).

aspectRatio.wide: posters keep their size; the row shows more. Hero text column capped at 960 du.
aspectRatio.narrowOrPortrait: the grid drops columns and the detail page stacks poster above facts.

inputModels.dpad: the reference. Focus is the only cursor.
inputModels.pointer: hover takes the unfocused->focused transition unchanged; keyboard focus keeps the spine.
inputModels.touch: no focus state, only pressed; the spine becomes a selected marker. Minimum target 44pt.

mustSurviveAPort: the focus signal's three parts, together
two type weights and one accent
